description: Source readers (spec/cli/sources.md, section 2). Each case reads the fixture file named by input as the project path file, with the recipe fixture of ../recipes named by recipe (or that fixture with the keys of set replaced), the import's object and the connection being imported; expected is readSourceFile's result, or refused the reasons. forbidden lists text that must appear nowhere in the result or its reasons.

cases.name: a headerless columns file is refused without quoting its first row
refused: sources/erp.columns.csv has no header row: its first line is not a list of field names; a columns file has exactly: table_catalog, table_schema, table_name, column_name, ordinal_position, data_type, is_nullable, primary_key_position.

refused: sources/erp.columns.csv, row 2: is_nullable is not YES or NO.

sources/t.columns.csv: the table "C" gives ordinal_position to some columns and not others.
sources/t.columns.csv: the table "D" gives two columns the same primary_key_position.
